page.overview:
Who is Sabit Rekush?

Sabit Rekush was a spokesman of the Landsraad's Internal Security Commission who requested response from Wensicia Corrino in 10219 AG after the Bene Gesserit Council on Wallach IX filed formal protest against House Corrino in assassination of Leto Atreides II. Category:Original Dune Category:Characters
